item.title: I built a live model of the Philippine grid. The code was the easy part.
item.description: Most of the code for my Visayas grid model was written by AI. That was the cheap part. Getting the power flow physically correct came down to domain knowledge no tool could supply.

item.title: How I Created and Deployed a Website From Scratch
item.description: A step-by-step guide to generating, improving, and deploying a personal website using AI and GitHub Pages — with minimal experience and at zero cost.

item.title: How to Build the Life You Actually Want
item.description: An essay on identifying authentic goals, subtracting borrowed expectations, and aligning daily life with what genuinely matters.

item.title: Why the Visayas Grid is the most interesting engineering problem in the Philippines
item.description: An isolated island grid, aggressive renewable targets, and aging infrastructure — what makes the Visayas one of the most complex power systems in Southeast Asia.
